SELECT 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t 
  JOIN login_events le ON t.user_id = le.user_id
  JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
  AND UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%PAYMENT%' 
GROUP BY 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) > 0.15
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument, 
  STDDEV(t.amount_usd) AS std_dev
FROM 
  transactions t 
  JOIN login_events le ON t.user_id = le.user_id
  JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
  AND UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%PAYMENT%' 
GROUP BY 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.instrument) >= 4 
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%PAYMENT%' THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.amount_usd) > 0.25

  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(*) as txn_count, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_count, 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / txn_count) * 100 as failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-45 days')
GROUP BY 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / txn_count) * 100 > 12
ORDER BY 
  failure_rate DESC;

SELECT 
  u.user_id, 
  u.full_name, 
  u.risk_level
FROM 
  users u
JOIN 
  transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE 
  u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH')
  AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
  AND t.created_at < date('now', '-60 days')
GROUP BY 
  u.user_id, u.full_name, u.risk_level
HAVING 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.instrument IN (SELECT instrument FROM transactions GROUP BY instrument HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND SUM(amount_usd) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM transactions) > 0.2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY 
  u.risk_level DESC;
